title: license show <id>
description: What <app> license show <id> answers with -o json, on envelope/v2: the one license the app took with that id, as license list's row gives it (license-list.schema.json), the one home of a license's fields. A refused file is license list's alone. The app's state, its trial and its features are license show's (license-show.schema.json). mankit's license check makes it for every app, so every app answers it alike.

kind.description: Always License, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets. A license file is of its own form, elderlygate/mankit/license/v2, so the two never meet.
